semanticChecks.subject: Known form rules and engineering delegation
semanticChecks.evidence: All three software Plan repetitions avoid reopening known field set, cancellation, nonempty-value protection, ordering, module scope and testing layers; actual results retain region, matching keys and detail-before-write prerequisites.

semanticChecks.subject: Unknowns remain visible
semanticChecks.evidence: Missing-region handling, confirmation UI or new retry policy remain unresolved; they are not automatically adopted from options. Known rules do not erase new feedback, source, metric or refund-module counterexamples in local regression.

semanticChecks.subject: Confirmed threshold and new conflict
semanticChecks.evidence: 50000 replaces old 30000, strict greater-than preserved; secondary 80000 material produces a visible new conflict in copied body instead of reopening old choice.

semanticChecks.subject: Academic known requirements
semanticChecks.evidence: Three paper repetitions keep interactive Plan definition, blind review, same confirmed information, 20 tasks, three repetitions, two reviewers and 1200-character main text with appendix excluded; future statistical method and unperformed results remain unresolved.

semanticChecks.subject: Data missingness and final guard
semanticChecks.evidence: Denominator and missing-answer handling remain unresolved; no exclusion, zero-imputation or missing-to-uncompleted mapping is silently adopted; no fabricated calculations. Valid coordinated prohibition survives final fidelity check.

semanticChecks.subject: Complete translation control
semanticChecks.evidence: Plan returns no questions; final instruction retains translated-text-only delivery without unsolicited analysis.

unresolved.subject: Historical paper 502 root cause
unresolved.note: Future safe diagnostics and successful replay cannot recover the original missing log.

unresolved.subject: Rewritten final reminders and verbose unknown-answer explanations
unresolved.evidence: Round-one paper contains 14 copied-body reminders for seven unresolved questions; model rewrites can duplicate platform-owned conditions. Preserve new conflicts while improving merging.

unresolved.subject: Low-value paper delivery questions and unsolicited new strategies
unresolved.evidence: Paper outline/test-list organization and form retry/cache proposals remain optional quality concerns; do not turn them into mandatory user decisions or silently add selected-looking requirements.

unresolved.subject: Recommendation applicability wording
unresolved.evidence: Missing-region preserve/let-user-decide-fill and cache options need explicit region verification, pre-confirmation and detail-query prerequisites; current three software repetitions contain no explicit keys-alone or ignore-region alternatives, not proof of all semantic variants.

unresolved.subject: Generic research output template
unresolved.evidence: Software experiment paper inherits generic time/space scope and stratification wording that is not directly justified by the requested task.

unresolved.subject: Provider repairs and tail latency
unresolved.evidence: Four response failures repaired within budget; observed end-to-end paper Plan 61000 ms and form final 50000 ms class outliers. End-to-end and model-call durations differ; no exact bottleneck or missing usage is inferred.

previousEvidence.policy: First failed results and intermediate negative regressions are retained; success never overwrites them.
